selection_rule: Final update for every fit/family; validation diagnostic only. No seed/failure removal, no confirmation tuning.
training_objective: Uniform observed behavior decision states; exact conditional finite-cell expectation of masked Q MSE plus soft posterior BCE. Behavior is independent of cell. Teacher-only posterior and Q use TRAIN-fitted confusion. No DQN/policy-gradient convergence claim.

statistics.unit: Five independent fits; within-fit paired common worlds and deterministic latent seeds
statistics.method: Two-sided paired Student t intervals on five fit means, df=4; Bonferroni alpha=.05/4 per interval. Distributional assumption explicit; five fits give low power.
statistics.benefit_gate: Adjusted lower confidence limit > .02 for a declared contrast and split. Report every primary result; broader IID-and-OOD benefit requires both splits.
statistics.secondary: Clocked contrasts, controller differences, interactions, raw_history and fitted Bayes+DP comparisons are descriptive. Actual-outcome calibration, per-action fitted-oracle regret, correctness, submit rate, information gain, events, recovery and complete measured costs all reported.
statistics.cost_gate: No compute-saving claim from event count. End-to-end CPU/wall, content calls, bytes, persistence, model load, training and export costs reported separately. No hardware energy measurements, hence no energy claim. Small-sample timing differences descriptive.
statistics.failure_rule: A failed formal run is retained, reported and blocks that scientific comparison; never silently dropped. Implementation corrections require new source version and documented whole affected-cohort rerun.

freeze_rule: Publish protocol and implementation before formal fits. Publish all 25 fitted policies and hashes before generating any IID/OOD confirmation worlds.
limits: New synthetic marked-symbol memory task, not general language reasoning or production integration.
Finite projected process with at most one internal event per elapsed interval and end-interval recovery.
Bank forecasts free Brownian endpoints conditional on active state, not future task success or reset-aware multi-horizon outcomes.
Native executor evaluates exported finite transition tables and neural weights; it does not recompute erf/image sums online. Export table preparation and storage cost are charged separately.
Known domain levels are registered in export, while heldout worlds/labels/packets remain ungenerated until model freeze. Missing table context is rejected.
